'''Johin''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] that brought the news of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Pacification of Hyrol Preen Beta|decimation]] of the populace of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hyrol Preen Beta]] due to suspected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity.
